name: @turboslide/realtime
description: The room of one deck behind one framework free interface (gslides-parity SPEC-3 3.2): the operation stream in front of the revision log, presence, client bindings, the checkpoint and append locks, budgets and kill switch flags, with the memory, blob (every append a commit) and do (the realtime Worker's Durable Object) implementations, the room protocol as zod schemas with the SSE framing, the key builder, the admission caps and the checkpointer's coalescing rules; the room client and the pending store under client/.
